title: CBC news feeds not showing past June
summary: I have been using Newsblur for several years now to keep up with international, national, and local news. After June of this year CBC news stopped updating. If I go to the website I can read the current news stories. How can I get CBC to start updating again?
body_markdown:
[Larryjb](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/Larryjb)


September 7, 2026, 7:14am 1


I have been using Newsblur for several years now to keep up with international, national, and local news. After June of this year CBC news stopped updating. If I go to the website I can read the current news stories.


How can I get CBC to start updating again?


[steanne](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/steanne)


September 7, 2026, 7:29am 2


what’s the feed address?


[Larryjb](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/Larryjb)


September 7, 2026, 7:41am 3


Actually, I just got it to work. But I had to do a browser search for CBC RSS feeds and found this page:


[https://www.cbc.ca/rss/](https://www.cbc.ca/rss/)


Then I add the link addresses manually.


But if I use the Newsblur + and search for CBC BC, I do get a result to add. But I can’t read anything from that result past June. If I add the feed manually from the above web page, I can get current stories.
